difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the internal hom out of a derived colimit of perfect objects as the derived limit of the tensor products with the duals (statement lines 13415-13429). The proof (proof lines 13431-13446) rewrites the right-hand side as a derived limit of internal homs, compares the defining triangles of the derived limit and of the derived colimit, and reduces to the formal identity prod RSheafHom(K_n, E) = RSheafHom(bigoplus K_n, E). H2: one triangle comparison plus a formal identity. The statement carries the author's slogan environment, delivered verbatim.
